Analytical Engineer (m/f/d) — Nordwind Analytics GmbH

About the role
Nordwind Analytics builds measurement tooling for mid-market e-commerce brands. Our
platform ingests traffic and conversion events and turns them into channel-level
performance reporting. We are hiring an Analytical Engineer to own the transformation
layer between raw ingestion and the reporting models our customers see.

What you will do
- Own batch transformation pipelines end to end, from source ingestion through warehouse
  modelling to the datasets consumed by reporting.
- Build and document reusable SQL models across landing, intermediate and aggregated
  layers so that business logic is defined once.
- Keep orchestrated workflows reliable: scheduling, monitoring, backfills and change
  control through version-controlled repositories.
- Design data quality checks for completeness, uniqueness, validity and freshness, and
  make failures visible before they reach a dashboard.
- Partner with analysts and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous measurement
  questions into well-defined datasets.

What we are looking for
- Strong SQL and practical experience modelling in a cloud warehouse.
- Experience with an orchestration tool such as Airflow.
- Comfort with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
- An interest in attribution and marketing measurement.
- Clear written communication: you will document models for other people to reuse.

Nice to have
- Python for pipeline and reporting automation.
- Experience with BI tools and semantic layers.
- Exposure to A/B testing or incrementality measurement.

Location and terms
The role is based in Berlin, Germany, with a hybrid pattern of two days per week in the
office. We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates who
require a work permit for Germany.
